summary: Synchronous thread-safe read wrapper: acquires the stream lock via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a4), performs the actual read by forwarding (a1, a2, a3, a4) to sub_58806E, releases via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a4), and returns the inner read result unchanged. Used as a shared read primitive across deserialization, file enumeration, scene parsing, mesh loading and file-write paths.

local_names.a4: stream/buffer handle used for the lock scope

operations.description: Acquire the stream lock with StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a4) using argument 4 as the stream handle.
Perform the actual read: v4 = sub_58806E(a1, a2, a3, a4), forwarding all four arguments unchanged.
Release the lock with AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a4) before returning.
Return the inner read result v4 from sub_58806E unchanged.

Used as a shared synchronous read primitive by deserialization, file enumeration, scene parsing, mesh loading and file-write paths, e.g. BinaryDataDeserialization (0x004054E0), MemoryAllocationWithBufferRead (0x004080F0), FileEnumerationByExtension (0x00421B10), BufferedFileReader (0x00534F90), MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader (0x00550AD0), SceneFileTopLevelParser (0x0055B200) and FileWriteWithBackendDispatch (0x00566C00).
